title: POST /v1/records/{recordId}/decisions and POST /v1/reports/{reportId}/decisions request
description: Records one blinded screening vote (see blinding.md). The record endpoint votes the title_abstract stage; the report endpoint votes the full_text stage. reasonCode is required with exclude and must be a global or project code; it is forbidden with include. Re-voting before unblinding supersedes the reviewer's earlier vote (the API keeps the latest; earlier rows stay for audit). Voting on an item with an open conflict answers 409 conflict_open.
